description: Does God wait for us to clean ourselves up before He'll love us? In this message at First Baptist Church of Hewitt, Dr. Marrow unpacks Romans 5:8 showing how God's grace moves toward us first — not as a reward for getting our lives together, but right in the middle of our sin and struggle. It's a clear picture of grace as something God does before we ever seek Him.
title: God's Grace Seeks Us
